had been deputed to him, could not help saying:
«Well, Sir, did your master want men, by sending
me an ambassador without a beard ?> - <<If my sove-
reingn had thought», replied the proud Spaniard,
<that merit consisted in a beard, he would have sent
you a he goat, and not a gentleman, as I am».
